title: On Shooting the birds over the north field
subtitle: 动物世界 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）
meta: 主题语境：动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）　|　核心词汇：shoot　|　正文 353 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 shoot 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 the grower ① shot the birds over the north field twice over, and every buyer in the greenhouse said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three summers on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the grower ② shoots the birds over the north field year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ shoot the birds over the north field at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ shot the birds over the north field before — a line in the ledger for August 1957 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Shooting the birds over the north field twice over, the grower said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the crate at the far shelf, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ shoot the whole ceremony on film year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Shoot the whole ceremony on film at once and never mention it again.

By 1970 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the ledger, and a new buyer from the next greenhouse ⑧ shoots the whole ceremony on film twice over every summer without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the shelf, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ shot the birds over the north field again when nobody else would.

⑩ To shoot the birds over the north field, my mother said in 1975, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the greenhouse remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the greenhouse forgets, somebody shoots the birds over the north field year after year again and somebody must shoot the birds over the north field twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 射击（一般过去式 shot the birds over the north field：1963 年种植户头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 射击（一般现在 shoots the birds over the north field：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 射击（不定式 to shoot the birds over the north field：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 射击（过去完成时 had shot the birds over the north field：1957 年八月的收成账上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 射击（动名词 shooting the birds over the north field 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 拍摄（shoot the whole ceremony on film：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去拍摄把整个仪式拍了下来）
G. v. 拍摄（shoot the whole ceremony on film：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 射击（后段两处：新来的收购人照例 shoots the whole ceremony on film，而母亲又一次 shot the birds over the north field）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 shoot 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1963 the grower shot the birds over the north field twice over, and nobody in the greenhouse forgot it.
Even now the grower shoots the birds over the north field year after year whenever the greenhouse asks.
Shooting the birds over the north field twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever shoot the whole ceremony on film year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new buyer from the next greenhouse shoots the whole ceremony on film twice over every summer, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother shot the birds over the north field again, and the greenhouse remembered that half.
